answer: A new agent should not earn weight until it has forged a chain of sequential delay-function heartbeats, one per epoch, each anchored to the previous result and the public seed. Even in a barren tundra of cheap compute, the chain cannot be parallelized, so an attacker running 1,000 fake identities must pay for 1,000 separate dedicated machines for the whole waiting period, while an honest agent pays once.
